rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), CbcReports/ConstEntities
rules.statement: Every constituent entity in scope has country-by-country figures for the fiscal year before the report is made.

rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), Summary
rules.statement: Every ledger account with a movement or balance in the year carries a country-by-country category, so no amount is left out of the summary figures.

rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), TIN
rules.statement: Every constituent entity has a tax identification number, or the value NOTIN with the reason it has none.

rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), BizActivities
rules.statement: Every jurisdiction reports at least one main business activity.

rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), Summary/Revenues
rules.statement: Total revenue of every jurisdiction equals its unrelated plus related party revenue.
A difference of more than EUR 1,000,000 between the report and the consolidated statements is explained by reconciliation items.

rules.source: OECD CbC XML Schema User Guide v2.0 (2019), AdditionalInfo
rules.statement: Figures are read from the books; figures entered or imported by hand are named in the additional information.

rules.source: OECD GloBE Information Return XML Schema User Guide (2025), JurisdictionSection
rules.statement: Every jurisdiction of the group has a passed safe harbour test or an approved jurisdiction computation.

rules.source: OECD GloBE Information Return XML Schema User Guide (2025)
rules.statement: No mandatory element of the GloBE information return is left without a value from the records.
